description: This Java class 'VisualTheme' defines a visual theme for widgets in the OFBiz framework. It includes properties such as ID, display name, description, and screenshots, and methods to initialize from XML, retrieve properties, and generate a string representation.

classes.name: VisualTheme
classes.description: Represents a visual theme with properties like ID, display name, description, and screenshots, initialized from an XML element.

methods.name: getVisualThemeId
methods.description: Returns the ID of the visual theme.

methods.name: getScreenshots
methods.description: Returns the list of screenshot locations for this theme.

methods.name: getDisplayName
methods.description: Expands and returns the display name based on provided context.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Expands and returns the description based on provided context.

methods.name: VisualTheme Constructor
methods.description: Initializes a VisualTheme instance from a ModelTheme and an XML element, extracting the ID, display name, description, and screenshots.

methods.name: toString
methods.description: Returns a string representation of the VisualTheme object.
